<!--
  Noise-covariate overlay of conditional-estimand coverage vs sample size
  (manuscript / corroboration fragment).

  Purpose. Compare C_betaHhat = coverage of the conditional estimand theta(Hhat)
  (the Theorem-2 target) as a function of n ACROSS noise-covariate counts, at the
  borderline null theta_dagger(H) = 1.0. Each noise level is a separate sweep run
  of mr_coverage_sweep_h10.qmd with a different k_random_noise and run_tag; this
  fragment reads their pooled grids and overlays them, so the reader can see
  whether the conditional-coverage curve dips as the candidate family is enlarged
  by distractor covariates, and whether any dip shrinks with n.

  The DGM (and hence theta_dagger / the beta(Hhat) eval frame) is identical across
  the runs -- k_random_noise adds standard-normal covariates to the ANALYSIS pool
  in the recorder only, not to the harm-generating DGM -- so the curves are
  apples-to-apples.

  Reads ONLY the pooled grids written by save_coverage_grid()
  (mr_coverage_grid_<run_tag>.rds: a list with `coverage`, `length`, `bias`,
  `manifest`, `truth`, `built`) plus ggplot2 -- no forestsearch, no DGM, no
  simulation -- so it renders in seconds. Missing grids are skipped with a warning
  so a partially-run comparison still plots. Defines @fig-mr-coverage-knoise-h10.
-->

```{r mr-knoise-fig-setup-h10}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(ggplot2)

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || all(is.na(a))) b else a

# ── Runs to overlay (one grid per noise-covariate count) ─────────────────────
# List the sweep run_tags to compare. The noise count k is parsed from each tag's
# "knoise<k>" token (falling back to NA / the tag string if absent). Produce each
# grid by rendering mr_coverage_sweep_h10.qmd with k_random_noise <- k and the
# matching run_tag, then make the grids visible here (see payload_dir below).
run_tags <- c("m1_h10_knoise0_s1000",   # the S3 conditional-target run (k = 0)
              "m1_h10_knoise3_s1000",   # k = 3 distractor covariates
              "m1_h10_knoise6_s1000")   # k = 6 distractor covariates

# Where the grids live.
#   read_from_sweep = FALSE : read mr_coverage_grid_<tag>.rds from payload_dir
#                             (flat; copy the grids there, matching the other
#                             _sim_* fragments). payload_dir = NULL reads beside
#                             this fragment.
#   read_from_sweep = TRUE  : read each grid in place from mr_sweep/<tag>/.
payload_dir     <- "_payloads/"
read_from_sweep <- FALSE

# ── What to plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
target_pick    <- "C_betaHhat"   # conditional estimand theta(Hhat) — Theorem 2's target
estimator_pick <- "MR"           # single estimator: the corroboration is about MR coverage
block_pick     <- "H"            # harm block Hhat
method_pick    <- "consistency"  # "consistency" (FS) | any of consistency/dina/grf; >1 ⇒ facet by method
band           <- "wilson"       # "wilson" | "mc_se" | "none"

# ── Locate + load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.knoise_of <- function(tag) {
  m <- regmatches(tag, regexpr("knoise[0-9]+", tag))
  if (length(m)) as.integer(sub("knoise", "", m)) else NA_integer_
}
.grid_path <- function(tag) {
  fn <- sprintf("mr_coverage_grid_%s.rds", tag)
  if (isTRUE(read_from_sweep)) return(file.path("mr_sweep", tag, fn))
  pdir <- if (is.null(payload_dir))
    tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) getwd()) else payload_dir
  file.path(pdir, fn)
}

.truth1 <- NULL
.load_slice <- function(tag) {
  p <- .grid_path(tag)
  if (!file.exists(p)) { warning(sprintf("grid not found, skipping: %s", p)); return(NULL) }
  G <- readRDS(p)
  if (is.null(.truth1)) .truth1 <<- G$truth
  s <- G$coverage[G$coverage$target == target_pick &
                  G$coverage$estimator == estimator_pick &
                  G$coverage$block == block_pick &
                  G$coverage$subgroup_method %in% method_pick, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(s)) return(NULL)
  s$run_tag <- tag
  s$knoise  <- .knoise_of(tag)
  s
}

sl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(run_tags, .load_slice))
have_data <- !is.null(sl) && nrow(sl) > 0

# ── Labels + caption ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.lab_tgt <- c(C_dagger   = "marginal subgroup hazard ratio (C\u2020)",
              C_ddagger  = "controlled direct effect (C\u2021)",
              C_oracle   = "per-replicate oracle",
              C_betaHhat = "conditional subgroup hazard ratio \u03b2(\u0124)")[[target_pick]]
.lab_blk <- if (block_pick == "H") "harm subgroup \u0124" else "complement \u0124\u1d9c"

if (have_data) {
  sl <- sl[order(sl$subgroup_method, sl$knoise, sl$n_sample), ]
  klev <- sort(unique(sl$knoise))
  sl$knoise_f <- factor(sl$knoise, levels = klev,
                        labels = ifelse(is.na(klev), "n/a", sprintf("%d noise", klev)))
  multi_method <- length(unique(sl$subgroup_method)) > 1L

  .rng <- function(x) { u <- sort(unique(x[is.finite(x)]))
    if (length(u) <= 1L) format(u, big.mark = ",") else
      sprintf("%s-%s", format(min(u), big.mark = ","), format(max(u), big.mark = ",")) }
  ns_txt   <- .rng(sl$n_sims); gd_txt <- .rng(sl$gate_draws)
  meth_txt <- paste(sort(unique(sl$subgroup_method)), collapse = ", ")
  k_txt    <- paste(klev, collapse = ", ")
  thH      <- .truth1$marg_H  %||% NA_real_
  thHc     <- .truth1$marg_Hc %||% NA_real_
  band_txt <- if (band == "wilson") "Shaded bands are Wilson 95% intervals on each rate."
              else if (band == "mc_se") "Shaded bands span \u00b11 Monte-Carlo SE."
              else ""

  cap_knoise <- sprintf(paste0(
    "Empirical 95%% CI coverage of the %s for the %s estimator on the %s, vs per-trial ",
    "sample size n, overlaid across noise-covariate counts k \u2208 {%s} (each a separate ",
    "sweep run at the same DGM; noise covariates enter the analysis pool only). ",
    "True $\\theta^{\\dagger}(H) = %.2f$, $\\theta^{\\dagger}(H^{c}) = %.2f$; %s simulations per ",
    "cell, %s MR draws; detector(s): %s. Dashed line = 0.95 nominal. %s All rates ",
    "conditional on identifying a subgroup."),
    .lab_tgt, estimator_pick, .lab_blk, k_txt, thH, thHc, ns_txt, gd_txt, meth_txt, band_txt)
} else {
  cap_knoise <- sprintf(paste0(
    "Coverage of the %s vs sample size, overlaid across noise-covariate counts. ",
    "**Placeholder \u2014 to be populated from the per-run coverage grids ",
    "(mr_coverage_grid_<run_tag>.rds for run_tags: %s).**"),
    .lab_tgt, paste(run_tags, collapse = ", "))
}

.ph <- function(lab) ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = lab, size = 4, colour = "grey50") + theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mr-coverage-knoise-h10
#| fig-cap: !expr cap_knoise
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
if (!have_data) {
  .ph("Pending per-run coverage grids")
} else {
  p <- ggplot(sl, aes(n_sample, coverage, colour = knoise_f, fill = knoise_f, group = knoise_f))
  if (band == "wilson")
    p <- p + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = wilson_lo, ymax = wilson_hi), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA)
  else if (band == "mc_se")
    p <- p + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = coverage - mc_se, ymax = coverage + mc_se), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA)
  y_lo <- min(0.80, min(sl$wilson_lo, sl$coverage, na.rm = TRUE))
  p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 2.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(sl$n_sample))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lo, 1.0)) +
    labs(x = "Sample size  n", y = "95% CI coverage",
         colour = "Noise covariates", fill = "Noise covariates",
         title = sprintf("%s coverage vs n, by noise-covariate count", .lab_tgt),
         subtitle = "Dashed line = 0.95 nominal") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  if (multi_method) p <- p + facet_wrap(~ subgroup_method)
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mr-coverage-knoise-h10
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
if (have_data) {
  disp <- sl[, c("subgroup_method", "knoise", "n_sample", "coverage", "mc_se",
                 "wilson_lo", "wilson_hi", "n_eff", "n_detected", "det_rate")]
  disp <- disp[order(disp$subgroup_method, disp$knoise, disp$n_sample), ]
  for (cc in c("coverage", "mc_se", "wilson_lo", "wilson_hi", "det_rate"))
    disp[[cc]] <- round(disp[[cc]], 3)
  knitr::kable(disp, row.names = FALSE,
               caption = sprintf("%s \u00b7 %s estimator \u00b7 %s block, by noise-covariate count.",
                                 target_pick, estimator_pick, block_pick))
}
```
